note: Digest pins for every external tool. Nothing here requires a Docker daemon at runtime: the Gobra jar is lifted from its image at build time, TLC is a jar, and Verus is a host binary.

verus.note: not on PATH by default; z3 4.12.5 ships alongside it

gobra.note: Gobra needs a JVM and a Z3 on PATH, NOT a container. viperproject/gobra publishes no release assets, but the jar can be exported straight from the registry with crane -- no docker daemon required, verified byte-identical to the docker-extracted jar. This matters because the Claude cloud base image has no responding daemon despite docker being listed as pre-installed.

tlc_container.verified: TLC2 2.19 launches inside it; the jar is bind-mounted read-only
tlc_container.note: Optional. The sha256-pinned jar is the determinism lever, not the JVM. Container JVM is 21, host is 17 -- TLC 2.19 runs on both, and a disagreement between them would itself be worth knowing.
